description.value: Big Bar Guest Ranch is an authentic working ranch in BC's Cariboo region, operating since 1936 and offering hand-built cabins and lodge rooms amid wide open grasslands near Clinton. The ranch actively promotes mountain biking on forest singletrack alongside horseback riding and fishing, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring this remote stretch of the Cariboo. Day visitors are also welcome to stop in for a meal or coffee at the lodge.
